updates.name: As a Metro by T-Mobile authorized dealer, I want to knock money off an accessory before I put it on the invoice, so that I can honour a price I have promised a customer without calling a manager
updates.custom_requirements:
## What this test is about
Reps are often asked to come down on the price of an accessory - a customer buying a phone and a case together expects something off, or a manager has promised a walk-in a deal. Accessory Sale lets the rep do that at the counter, without anyone else's approval, as long as the new price stays inside a range the business sets per item: a floor the store will not sell below, and a ceiling which is the item's normal list price, since this is a discount and never a mark-up. The rep can express the same discount in whichever way the conversation went - the price they agreed, a percentage off, or a number of dollars off - and all three arrive at the same figure. The discount is measured from the item's list price, and tax is then charged on the reduced price, not the original one, so the customer is never taxed on money they did not pay. This test walks a rep applying a discount all three ways to the same accessory and then putting it on the invoice at the reduced price.

## Related tickets
RTPL-2788 (Price Adjustments for Cart Items - Quick Sale flow), RTPL-2965 (Accessory price adjustment in the Payment flow)

## Preconditions
- The rep is signed in at store EZLOGIC.
- The till has no customer tablet paired to it, so the sale goes straight from the invoice to the payment screen.
- The invoice is empty at the start.
- This accessory is not taxed at this store: its Tax settings section shows Apply tax with Yes and No both unavailable, and Tax reads $0.00 throughout. The amounts below are therefore the discounted price with no tax added.

## Test data
- **Accessory to discount:** Item number 141761-5085, IPHONE 13 PRESIDIO PERFECT-CLEAR WITH GRIP+MS (CLEAR/CLEAR), list price $100.00, 100 on hand  _(verified: UAT3 2026-10-09, Browse accessories search and item detail panel: Price $100.00, Tax $0.00, Final price $100.00)_
- **Allowed range:** $96.00 MIN, $100.00 MAX  _(verified: UAT3 2026-10-09, Price adjustment section of the item detail panel)_
- **Agreed price to set:** $98.00  _(verified: UAT3 2026-10-09, typed live - Discount ($2.00), Final price $98.00, accepted and added to the invoice)_
- **Percentage to take off:** 2 percent  _(verified: UAT3 2026-10-09, typed live - Discount ($2.00), Final price $98.00)_
- **Dollars to take off:** $3.00  _(verified: UAT3 2026-10-09, typed live - Discount ($3.00), Final price $97.00)_

## Screens (design reference)
- **Item detail with the Price adjustment panel** — screenshot: `screens/live-2026-10-09-01-discount-141761.png` (attach from the run folder)
- **Invoice with the discounted line** — screenshot: `screens/live-2026-10-09-02-invoice-discounted.png` (attach from the run folder)
- **Payment screen asking for the discounted price** — screenshot: `screens/live-2026-10-09-03-payment-discounted.png` (attach from the run folder)

## Automation Notes
- The money check that matters most: the invoice line, Total due and the payment screen's Collect amount must all carry the discounted $98.00, never the $100.00 list price. A panel that shows the discount but bills the customer in full is the worst outcome here.
- Step 6 is real behaviour, not a test glitch: switching method keeps the number in the box and re-reads it in the new method. Assert that the out-of-range result is refused there - a switch that silently let a 98 percent discount through would be a defect.
- This item is not taxed, so this case cannot show tax being charged on the discounted price; that check is waiting on a taxable accessory with a price range and is not part of this case.
- Type into the Amount box key by key, as a person would; select the whole box before typing a new figure. Setting the value directly without key presses leaves the panel unchanged.
- Clean up afterwards by cancelling the sale (Cart options, Cancel cart) so the next run starts with an empty invoice.
- If 141761-5085 no longer shows a range ($96.00 MIN, $100.00 MAX), has sold out, or is refused as not approved when added, do not hunt for another item alone: contact the manual QA team to get an approved, in-stock accessory with a price range for this store.

steps.action: Login into the app
steps.expected: The dashboard opens and the header shows STORE ID EZLOGIC, DEALER CODE 30247306 and STATION showing the station the rep signed in on.

steps.action: On the dashboard, click the Accessory Sale tile
steps.expected: The Accessory Sale screen opens with the heading ACCESSORY SALE and an empty invoice reading Total due $0.00.

steps.action: Click Browse accessories, type 141761-5085 into the search box, then click that row
steps.expected: The list narrows to one row: 141761-5085, IPHONE 13 PRESIDIO PERFECT-CLEAR WITH GRIP+MS (CLEAR/CLEAR), QTY 100, SRP $100.00. Clicking it opens a panel headed Item detail 141761-5085 with the item name IPHONE 13 PRESIDIO PERFECT-CLEAR WITH GRIP+MS (CLEAR/CLEAR), showing Price $100.00, Tax $0.00, Discount ($0.00) and Final price $100.00, and the buttons Add accessories and Close.

steps.action: Open the Price adjustment section of that panel
steps.expected: The section opens showing a Range of $96.00 MIN and $100.00 MAX - the least the store will sell this item for, and its normal list price as the ceiling. Below it are three ways of taking money off, labelled Price, Percent and Amount, and an Amount box prompting Type here.

steps.action: Choose Price and type the agreed price into the Amount box
steps.expected: The panel recalculates in place: Discount reads ($2.00) - the list price of $100.00 less the $98.00 agreed - Tax reads $0.00 and Final price reads $98.00. The value is inside the range so nothing is flagged and Add accessories stays available.

steps.action: Click Percent
steps.expected: The Amount box keeps the number already typed and now reads it as a percentage: 98.00%. That would be 98 percent off, so the panel shows Discount ($98.00) and Final price $2.00, the box is outlined as wrong, the message Price below minimum value $96.00. appears and Add accessories is greyed out. Nothing at this price can reach the invoice.

steps.action: Select everything in the Amount box and type the percentage to take off
steps.expected: The refusal clears and the panel reads Discount ($2.00) - 2 percent of the $100.00 list price - Tax $0.00 and Final price $98.00. The new method replaces the previous discount rather than stacking on top of it.

steps.action: Click Amount, select everything in the Amount box and type the dollars to take off
steps.expected: The panel recalculates again: Discount reads ($3.00), Tax $0.00 and Final price $97.00. All three ways measure the discount from the same $100.00 list price.

steps.action: Click Price, select everything in the Amount box, type the agreed price again and click Add accessories
steps.expected: Before adding, the panel reads Discount ($2.00) and Final price $98.00. After Add accessories the panel closes and the invoice lists one line, IPHONE 13 PRESIDIO PERFECT-CLEAR WITH GRIP+MS (CLEAR/CLEAR) $98.00. Inventory reads $98.00 and Total due reads $98.00 - the price the rep agreed, not the $100.00 list price.

steps.action: Click the discounted line in the invoice, open Price adjustment, then click Close
steps.expected: The panel reopens headed Item detail 141761-5085 showing Discount ($2.00) and Final price $98.00, with Price still selected as the method and 98.00 still in the Amount box, so the rep can see what was given away. The buttons offered are Remove from invoice and Update item. Close leaves the invoice unchanged at Total due $98.00.

steps.action: Click Continue
steps.expected: The PAYMENT screen opens reading Collect $98.00 with cash, card, or split the payment across multiple methods. The invoice panel reads Inventory $98.00, Total due $98.00 and Balance due $98.00 - the customer is asked for the discounted price.

steps.action: Stop here - do NOT take any payment and do NOT click Submit
steps.expected: The sale is left unpaid on the payment screen. Nothing is sold and the store's stock count is untouched.

updates.name: As a Metro by T-Mobile authorized dealer, I want to be stopped when I try to sell an accessory below the store's floor price or above its list price, so that I cannot give away margin or overcharge a customer by mistyping
updates.custom_requirements:
## What this test is about
Letting a rep set their own price at the counter is only safe if there is a fence around it. The business sets a floor per accessory - the least the store is prepared to sell it for - and the ceiling is the item's ordinary list price, because this is a discount and a rep must never be able to charge a customer more than the shelf price. There is deliberately no manager override in this version: a price outside the range is simply refused, for everyone, with a message that names the limit that was breached so the rep knows what they are allowed to do. This matters in both directions. Below the floor the store loses margin on every sale, and a mistyped figure - a missing decimal point - could hand an accessory over for almost nothing. Above the ceiling the customer is overcharged. This test types a price just outside each end of the range and checks that both are refused and that neither reaches the invoice.

## Related tickets
RTPL-2788 (Price Adjustments for Cart Items - Quick Sale flow)

## Preconditions
- The rep is signed in at store EZLOGIC.
- The till has no customer tablet paired to it.
- The invoice is empty at the start.
- This accessory is not taxed at this store: its Tax settings section shows Apply tax with Yes and No both unavailable, and Tax reads $0.00 throughout. The amounts below are therefore the discounted price with no tax added.

## Test data
- **Accessory to price:** Item number 141761-5085, IPHONE 13 PRESIDIO PERFECT-CLEAR WITH GRIP+MS (CLEAR/CLEAR), list price $100.00, 100 on hand  _(verified: UAT3 2026-10-09, Browse accessories search and item detail panel)_
- **Allowed range:** $96.00 MIN, $100.00 MAX  _(verified: UAT3 2026-10-09, Price adjustment section of the item detail panel)_
- **Price below the floor:** $95.00  _(verified: UAT3 2026-10-09, typed live - refused with Price below minimum value $96.00.)_
- **Price exactly on the floor:** $96.00  _(verified: UAT3 2026-10-09, typed live - accepted, Final price $96.00)_
- **Price exactly on the ceiling:** $100.00  _(verified: UAT3 2026-10-09, typed live - accepted, Final price $100.00)_
- **Price above the ceiling:** $101.00  _(verified: UAT3 2026-10-09, typed live - refused with Price above maximum value $100.00.)_

## Screens (design reference)
- **Item detail with the Price adjustment panel** — screenshot: `screens/live-2026-10-09-01-discount-141761.png` (attach from the run folder)

## Automation Notes
- Check both halves of each refusal: the message appears AND Add accessories is greyed out. A message shown while the item can still be added at the bad price is the defect this case exists to catch.
- The two exact-edge prices must be accepted. A floor or ceiling that refuses its own value is a defect too.
- Each message names the limit that was breached, so assert the amount in the text as well as the wording.
- Type into the Amount box key by key, as a person would; select the whole box before typing a new figure. Setting the value directly without key presses leaves the panel unchanged.
- There is no manager override in this version, so expect a flat refusal for every user and no approval prompt anywhere in the flow.
- If 141761-5085 no longer shows a range ($96.00 MIN, $100.00 MAX), has sold out, or is refused as not approved when added, do not hunt for another item alone: contact the manual QA team to get an approved, in-stock accessory with a price range for this store.

steps.action: Login into the app
steps.expected: The dashboard opens and the header shows STORE ID EZLOGIC, DEALER CODE 30247306 and STATION showing the station the rep signed in on.

steps.action: On the dashboard, click the Accessory Sale tile
steps.expected: The Accessory Sale screen opens with the heading ACCESSORY SALE and an empty invoice reading Total due $0.00.

steps.action: Click Browse accessories, type 141761-5085 into the search box, then click that row
steps.expected: The list narrows to one row: 141761-5085, IPHONE 13 PRESIDIO PERFECT-CLEAR WITH GRIP+MS (CLEAR/CLEAR), QTY 100, SRP $100.00. Clicking it opens a panel headed Item detail 141761-5085 with the item name IPHONE 13 PRESIDIO PERFECT-CLEAR WITH GRIP+MS (CLEAR/CLEAR), showing Price $100.00, Tax $0.00, Discount ($0.00) and Final price $100.00, and the buttons Add accessories and Close.

steps.action: Open the Price adjustment section of that panel
steps.expected: The section opens showing a Range of $96.00 MIN and $100.00 MAX - the least the store will sell this item for, and its normal list price as the ceiling. Below it are three ways of taking money off, labelled Price, Percent and Amount, and an Amount box prompting Type here.

steps.action: Choose Price and type a price one dollar below the store's floor
steps.expected: The price is refused. The message Price below minimum value $96.00. appears under the Amount box, the box is outlined as wrong, and Add accessories is greyed out. The panel figures follow what was typed (Discount ($5.00), Final price $95.00) but cannot be added. The typed value stays in the box so the rep can correct it.

steps.action: Select everything in the Amount box and type the floor price exactly
steps.expected: The price is accepted: the message disappears, the box is no longer outlined, Discount reads ($4.00), Final price $96.00, and Add accessories is available. The floor itself is an allowed price.

steps.action: Select everything in the Amount box and type the list price exactly
steps.expected: Also accepted: no message, Discount ($0.00), Final price $100.00, and Add accessories available. The ceiling itself is an allowed price.

steps.action: Select everything in the Amount box and type a price one dollar above the item's list price
steps.expected: Refused with Price above maximum value $100.00. - naming the list price as the ceiling. The box is outlined as wrong and Add accessories is greyed out. The panel shows Final price $101.00 but it cannot be added, so a rep cannot charge more than the shelf price.

steps.action: Clear the Amount box completely
steps.expected: The refusal message disappears and the panel returns to the item's ordinary figures - Price $100.00, Tax $0.00, Discount ($0.00) and Final price $100.00 - with Add accessories available again.

steps.action: Stop here - click Close without adding the item
steps.expected: The panel closes. The invoice is still empty at Inventory $0.00 and Total due $0.00. No out-of-range price reached the invoice.
